headline: More than half of Kyrgyzstanis work in the shadow economy — World Bank
summary: The World Bank reports that over half of Kyrgyzstan's employed population works in the informal economy. It cites data showing the share of citizens working informally in 2023.
why: Large informal employment limits tax revenue and social-insurance coverage, which matters for fiscal stability and the reliability of official economic statistics in emerging economies.
original_headline: Больше половины кыргызстанцев работают в тени — Всемирный банк
